title: Laurel Creek Family Dental
brief: I'm the office manager at Laurel Creek Family Dental, a six-chair general practice in East Sacramento run by Dr. Maren Okafor. We want more new patients, especially implant and clear aligner cases, not just cleanings. Our current site is slow on phones and the call button is buried. Phone (916) 555-0148, 2715 Alder Park Way, Sacramento, CA 95819. Hours: Monday to Thursday 7:30am–5pm, Friday 7:30am–1pm. Services: exams and cleanings, fillings, crowns, implants, clear aligners, and same-week emergency visits for new and existing patients. We take most PPO plans and have an in-house membership plan for patients without insurance (price to confirm, so leave a placeholder). A phone visitor should be able to call or request an appointment in one tap. The request form must not ask for any medical details and must not pretend it was sent, because nothing is connected yet. No patient testimonials, before-and-after photos, star ratings or "best dentist" badges: we don't have written permission or awards.

source.adaptation: Office manager's voice from the persona: high-value cases over cleanings, slow mobile site with a buried call button, HIPAA caution (no clinical details on web forms), written authorization before testimonials. Practice, dentist and street are fictional; the phone is in the reserved 555-01xx range.
